FAQ

Do you take walk-ins?

Walk-ins are welcome, but booking ahead guarantees your spot and barber.

How do I book?

Tap Book, or just message us right here and our assistant books you in seconds.

Do you do beard work and shaves?

Absolutely. Beard shaping, lineups, and classic hot-towel straight-razor shaves.

What forms of payment do you take?

Cash and all major cards. Tips appreciated, never expected.
